text.tspan: A supplier offered me tickets to the cricket final, can I accept?
may a store employee accept hospitality (event tickets) from a supplier
No. Event tickets from a supplier count as hospitality and must be declined [Anti-Bribery Policy §5.2].
Report the offer to the Compliance Officer within 24 hours [§7.1].
